title: Cauliflower-Asparagus Baked Penne with Ricotta, Mozzarella & Parsley

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem. Roughly chop into ½-inch pieces.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, uncover, add cauliflower, pasta, and salt; stir for a few seconds. Cook until pasta is almost tender, about 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus and cut into 1-inch pieces. Set aside.
Peel and mince garlic; place in a large bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half to the bowl with the garlic (reserving the rest for garnish).
When the pasta is almost tender, add asparagus to the pot; continue to cook until the pasta and veggies are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, add tomato sauce, ricotta, and spices to the bowl with the garlic and parsley; whisk to combine the sauce.
When the pasta and veggies are done, drain in a colander. Add pasta and veggies to the bowl with the sauce; stir to combine.
Transfer the saucy pasta to a large baking dish, spread out in an even layer, and sprinkle with cheese. Place baking dish in the oven and bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, 10-12 minutes.
To serve, divide pasta bake between bowls and top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
